name: webentic-client-nextjs
title: Webentic Client for Next.js
docs: You'll need to set the following environment variables in your project: `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBENTIC_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBENTIC_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.
You'll need to set the following environment variables in your project: `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.
